title: The Kernel of Good Strategy
coreMove: Assemble diagnosis, guiding policy, and coherent action into one testable structure.
sourcePressure: The supported core is diagnosis, guiding policy, and coherent action: name the obstacle, choose the directional response, and align action rather than treating any one part as enough.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The kernel is a slogan, template, or three separate checklist items.

sourceAnchors.name: diagnosis, guiding policy, coherent action
sourceAnchors.detail: the skeleton and source sidecar identify these three parts as the kernel of good strategy
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The kernel works only when diagnosis, guiding policy, and coherent action stay connected as one chain.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

skillTargets: distinguish kernel from its generic imitation in a new scenario
choose the action that performs assemble diagnosis, guiding policy, and coherent action into one testable structure. rather than merely describing it

tryThisNowSpec: In 30 to 90 seconds, write the current decision as one obstacle, one chosen response, and one action that would visibly test kernel in your actual situation.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
